description: Source code implementing ASN.1 parsing and encoding functions for various cryptographic key types in OpenSSL's EVP library.

methods.name: parse_key_type
methods.description: Parses ASN.1 object identifier to determine key type.

methods.description: Legacy decoding of private keys based on type.

methods.description: Counts number of elements in ASN.1 sequence to determine key format.

methods.name: d2i_AutoPrivateKey
methods.description: Automatically detects key format and decodes accordingly.
